https://jobs.ajg.com/jobs/59641?lang=en-.desc: Introduction Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging. Overview Overview At Gallagher Centre of Excellence, you'll help model catastrophe loss potential for insurance and reinsurance portfolios. You'll work with colleagues in India and the US to prepare data, check exposures, and turn model results into clear summaries. The work changes often. So you'll need to learn quickly, stay organised, and adapt when priorities shift. You'll be part of a team that supports global service, regulatory needs, and quicker turnaround for clients. How You’ll Make an Impact You'll prepare and clean data so it can be used in catastrophe models. That means checking records, tidying spreadsheets, and using SQL and Excel to help keep the inputs accurate. You'll also help geocode exposures, apply model settings, and run analysis that shows possible loss outcomes. You'll turn results into clear reports, maps, and summaries that others can use to make decisions. You'll also work with lead analysts, share progress, ask for feedback, and help keep work moving across locations and time zones. About You Here's what you'll bring to the role: You can explain technical ideas in simple English, in writing and in conversation. You’re comfortable using Excel and SQL to clean, check, and organise data. You can spot errors, compare results, and keep detail in view. You can work with changing deadlines and keep tasks moving. You’re comfortable learning new tools, models, and ways of working. You can work well with colleagues across locations and share updates clearly. You have studied, or can show practical ability in, a quantitative subject such as maths, statistics, economics, engineering, or a related area. It would help if you know about catastrophe modelling, insurance, reinsurance terms, GIS tools, or basic coding such as Python, R, or Matlab. If you’ve followed a different route, that’s fine too, as long as you can show the skills needed for the work. How you'll make an impact Job responsibilities Prepare and clean model input data using SQL and Excel. Check, scrub, and organise exposure data before modelling. Geocode exposures and apply the right model settings. Run catastrophe models and proprietary GRe models. Build exposure and loss summaries, reports, and maps. Test how changes in inputs affect model output. Work with lead analysts in the US and other locations to share progress and ask for feedback. Support renewals and other projects where timelines and deliverables shift. About you Qualifications: University Degree and 0-1 year prior relevant experience, or equivalent experience.
